title: Visitor, Iterator and Memento
idea: Visitor adds operations to a fixed set of classes without editing them. Iterator walks a collection without exposing its structure. Memento saves an object's state for undo.
points: Visitor: each element's `accept` calls the visitor method for its own type.
A new operation is a new visitor; a new element type edits every visitor.
Iterator: implement `Iterable` so callers use for-each and never see your storage.
Memento: the object exports a snapshot; by convention, the caretaker never reads it.

code.title: Visitor
code.caption: Two operations, tax and label, over two item types. The items never change.

walk.text: The visitor has one method per element type and a generic result `R`.
Each `accept` calls its own type's method. The choice depends on visitor and element: double dispatch.
Each operation lives in one class, with one case per item type.
`main` runs both visitors over every item in the cart.

code.title: Iterator
code.caption: Mail is stored in pages. The for-each loop sees one flat list and skips the empty page.

walk.text: `iterator()` returns a fresh cursor, so two loops never share a position.
`hasNext` skips finished and empty pages before it answers.
`next` throws `NoSuchElementException` past the end, as the contract requires.

code.title: Memento
code.caption: Save before each edit, restore to undo. The caretaker is a plain `Deque`.

walk.text: The memento is an immutable `record` copy of the private fields.
By convention only `Editor` creates and reads snapshots. To enforce it, return an empty `Memento` interface.
The caretaker pushes a snapshot before each change it may want to undo.
Each `pop` restores the most recent snapshot: last saved, first undone.

pitfalls: Avoid Visitor when new element types arrive often: each one edits every visitor.
Do not change a collection inside its own for-each; `java.util` iterators usually throw `ConcurrentModificationException`.
Copy mutable fields into a memento; sharing a live `List` breaks every undo.

quiz.q: What is the last line `MementoDemo` prints?
quiz.why: Two snapshots were pushed. The second `pop` returns the first snapshot, saved right after typing "Dear Bob".

takeaway: Visitor adds operations, Iterator hides storage, Memento saves state for undo.
